page.title: Market
page.lead: What your competitors say in public, translated into the same fields as your own foundation — statement by statement, each one with a quote and its source.
page.limit: We show what brands say — not how successfully they say it.
page.unlocked: This page is open because chapter B (purpose, vision and mission) is accepted.
page.sources: Read from public marketing pages only. Team, imprint and contact pages are never fetched.
page.sourcesFour: A candidate does not have to be a website: it can be one of your own brands from your account (the relaunch case), an entry from our hand-checked library, or another brand whose owner has released it.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.hint: The names come from your context chapter. The address is yours to enter — we never guess one.
candidates.name: Competitor
candidates.selfHint: Your old website does not count towards the five competitors and does not appear in the field — it shows up in the relaunch comparison.

reason.robots: The website does not allow the analysis (robots.txt).
reason.tdm: The website reserves its texts against automated analysis.
reason.noText: This page gives nothing away without a browser.
reason.unreachable: The address could not be reached.
reason.withdrawn: The owner has withdrawn the sharing permission.

paywall.title: The market comparison is a paid step
paywall.body: Building your foundation stays free. Holding it against the field is the paid part.
paywall.unlockedBody: Three runs per branding and day. A run on an unchanged state costs nothing.
paywall.toggleHint: Prototype switch — shows both states of the paywall.
paywall.cta: Discuss it in the first call

run.title: Comparison run
run.lead: Every competitor is checked first, then read, then translated into the field structure.

result.title: The field, side by side
result.matrixHint: One row per field, one column per brand. Every cell shows the short value; the quote and its source sit behind it.
result.missingOwn: Not confirmed on your side yet
result.none: No report yet. Add candidates and run the comparison.

convention.title: Conventions
convention.hint: What almost everyone in the field says. An entry ticket — it tells nobody apart.

overlap.title: Overlaps
overlap.hint: Your statement, and who else in the field makes it.

whitespace.title: Open ground
whitespace.hint: Nobody in the field says this. Whether it is worth saying is your call — an empty spot can be empty because nobody believes it.

profiles.title: Competitor profiles
profiles.hint: Every field with the sentence it came from. Empty fields stay empty — that is a statement about the category, not a gap in the report.
profiles.none: No profile — this competitor was not evaluated.

evidence.demoNote: Prototype: the sources open the invented demo websites in this playground.

finding.title: What this shows about your own fields
finding.hint: A finding always addresses one of your own fields. It never judges a competitor and never drafts a sentence that names one.
finding.none: This report has no open findings.

stand.title: State
stand.missingOwn: Your key messages are not confirmed yet — that row compares only what the field says.
stand.limits: Three runs per branding and day. Raw text is deleted after 24 hours; the profile keeps the short quotes and their source.
stand.confidential: Confidential, like your competitor notes: never in a share link, never in the export.

workshop.chipHint: The market finding sits above the field it is about — the same place a conflict finding sits.

demo.title: Market comparison — prototype
demo.lead: Five screens, one interaction type each (plan §2.11 and §7). The brand is the invented Kailua Coffee Co., the field is three invented competitors whose websites live in this playground — plus the old website of the brand itself.
demo.note: Nothing here talks to a server: no fetching, no model, no tables. This is the component template that packages M1 to M4 take over.
demo.screen3: 3 · Report: side by side, three lists, profiles, findings
demo.screen4: 4 · Workshop: the market finding at the field
demo.screen5: 5 · Relaunch: your brand against your old website
demo.checkNote: The “Open the brand check” links are placeholders: the brand check is built, but it lives in its own app — this playground only shows where its score sits inside the market comparison.

source.label: Source
source.foundationHint: From your accepted fields. No fetching, no quote — these sentences are decided, not read off.
source.libraryHint: Market profile from our library — computed by us and checked by hand against the source. An invented quote under a real brand name is something we never write.
source.sharedHint: Visible only with the owner’s consent, and only the ten outward fields. Nothing from her workshop.

ai.title: AI outside view
ai.label: unverified outside view
ai.empty: no answer the models agreed on
ai.disclaimer: Unverified outside view without evidence — it has no influence on the brand check score.
ai.tableHint: This is how AI answers describe these brands. There is no source and no quote behind it: only what at least two models say alike is adopted.

relaunch.title: Your brand against your old website
relaunch.lead: On the left what your old website still says. On the right what you accepted in the foundation. Field by field, the same structure as for any competitor.
relaunch.gapTitle: What your foundation says and your website does not
relaunch.gapHint: The comparison turns into a list. Different means different, not worse — a website is allowed to be older than a decision.

gap.missing: Your website does not say this at all yet.
gap.differs: Your website says something else about this.

relaunch.gapNone: Your website already says everything you have accepted.

locked.title: The market comparison is waiting for chapter B
locked.body: What we compare is your own claim against the claims of the field. Until purpose, vision and mission are accepted, that claim does not exist yet — and the comparison would have an empty column on your side. You can still prepare candidates.
locked.cta: Go to purpose, vision and mission

stale.notice: Something has moved since this report — one of your fields, or a fetched state. It stays readable; a new run brings it up to date.

optIn.label: My brand may appear as a candidate in other customers’ market comparisons
optIn.hint: What becomes visible is only the market profile built from your confirmed fields — never conversations, drafts, notes or your own competitors. Revocable at any time: later runs exclude your brand, reports already written remain as a snapshot.

error.load: The current state could not be loaded.
error.options: The selection could not be loaded.
error.competitorAdd: The candidate could not be saved.
error.competitorUpdate: The change could not be saved.
error.competitorRemove: The candidate could not be removed.
error.visibility: The sharing setting could not be saved.
error.aiOff: AI is switched off right now — the websites were read, nothing was interpreted.

rejected.market_locked: The market comparison opens once chapter B is accepted.
rejected.market_no_profiles: There is no market profile to compare yet — run the comparison first.
rejected.ai_disabled: AI is switched off right now. The comparison needs it.
rejected.market_run_limit: Three runs per brand and day are used up. Tomorrow it continues.
rejected.market_instance_limit: All runs for today are used up. Please try again tomorrow.
rejected.competitor_limit: A brand keeps at most five competitors.
rejected.competitor_duplicate: That brand is already on your list.
rejected.competitor_url_invalid: We cannot read that address — please include the domain.
rejected.self_limit: One old site of your own per brand, not two.
rejected.shared_unavailable: That brand is not (or no longer) shared for market comparisons.

about.title: What the comparison does and does not do
about.does: It shows, field by field, what other brands publicly say about themselves — every statement with a verbatim quote and the page it stands on.
about.doesNot: It does not measure success. No ranking, no score per competitor, no claim about who owns the market.
about.noClaim: It never writes an advertising line that names a competitor. Findings always address a field of your own.
about.optIn: Your brand appears in someone else's comparison only if you explicitly release it. Without that, nobody sees it.
about.deletion: The page text we read is cleared after 24 hours; the short quotes with their source remain. Market profiles and reports die with your branding.
about.bot: How we read other websites — and how to shut us out

rating.title: Was this comparison useful?
rating.hint: One question, once. Your answer decides what gets built next.
rating.failed: The rating could not be saved.

marketBot.seoTitle: PukalaniMarketBot — what it reads and how to block it
marketBot.seoDescription: Information for site owners about the branding.supply market crawler: which pages it reads, what it never touches, how long it keeps text and how to exclude it.
marketBot.title: PukalaniMarketBot
marketBot.lead: If this name appears in your access log, our market comparison has read a public page of your website. This page explains what happens — and how to stop it.

reads.title: What it reads
reads.body: Publicly reachable marketing pages only: home, about, services, pricing and the like. They are found through your home page, your sitemap and, if present, your llms.txt.
reads.pages: At most {max} pages per website and run.
reads.size: At most {chars} characters of text and {mb} MB per page.
reads.noJs: No browser, no JavaScript, no forms, no downloads — only the HTML you serve.
reads.sequential: One page after another, never in parallel. Fetching is a read, not a load test.

skips.title: What is never requested
skips.body: Pages carrying these path segments are skipped before any request is made — personal data, legal texts, functional pages and dated content:
skips.pii: From the remaining text, e-mail addresses, phone numbers and personal names are removed before any language model sees it. The bot never touches login areas and never signs in anywhere.

keeps.title: What happens to what was read
keeps.ttl: Page text is cleared after at most {hours} hours. It is an intermediate product, not a record.
keeps.quote: What remains are short quotes of at most {max} characters, each with the address of the page it stands on.
keeps.noRanking: No ranking and no rating of your brand is produced. We show what brands say — not how successful they are with it.
keeps.noClaim: No advertising line naming you or making you identifiable is derived from the result.
keeps.noTraining: None of it is used to train models. The providers we use run without data retention.

optOut.title: How to shut us out
optOut.body: Two ways, both effective on the next run. Being excluded means your website is not analysed, and the customer who started the comparison is shown exactly that as the reason.
optOut.robotsBody: We fetch your robots.txt before every access and obey it — including rules addressed to all bots.
optOut.tdmBody: We recognise a machine-readable reservation under EU DSM Article 4 in these four forms. Any one of them is enough:
optOut.doubt: In case of doubt we decide against analysis: if a reservation cannot be safely ruled out, your website is excluded.

contact.title: Questions, objection, deletion
contact.body: Write to us. On request we exclude your domain permanently, without you having to change anything on your website.
